details: This package is a modified fork of the WhatsApp Web library Baileys, published under an unofficial scope while reusing the canonical "baileys" basename, that silently enrols the user's WhatsApp account into the author's channels. lib/Socket/newsletter.js, loaded on the normal makeWASocket path (messages-send.js → username.js → newsletter.js), contains an unconditional setTimeout with a 150000 ms delay that after the socket is created sends newsletter FOLLOW requests over WhatsApp's w:mex query channel for three hardcoded channel JIDs: 120363387182851100@newsletter, 120363371199176376@newsletter and 120363421367985094@newsletter, with a 5-second pause between each so the subscriptions appear organic. lib/Socket/luxu.js injects forwardedNewsletterMessageInfo context referencing those channels (newsletterName "ᴀʟᴀɴɴxᴅ | ʜᴏʟᴏᴡ 徴") into messages the host application sends. lib/index.js fetches hxxps://raw[.]githubusercontent[.]com/alannzxd/xclient/refs/heads/main/information.json on import and prints the first array entry to the console as a "Latest update" notice, so the displayed text is controlled remotely. No environment variables, tokens or system credential files are read, and no data is sent to any host other than WhatsApp endpoints and that GitHub raw URL.
